name: execute_ui_action
description: Executes a hardware click or typing action on a UI element exposed by OS UIAutomation, guarded by real-time human confirmation.

action.description: The type of physical hardware action to dispatch.

target.description: The logical name or AutomationId of the target UI control node in the OS accessibility tree.

payload.description: Optional text payload to type into the target control (required if action is 'type').

rationale.description: REQUIRED. A concise, first-person explanation of your intent, explaining why this action is necessary and how it directly advances the user's task.
